scope: Bald blank-faced neutral with common tank/shorts and complete bare feet
Near/right shoulder-elbow-wrist-front fist is continuous and in front of torso; far hand behind
Modest ready stance, both feet point right with no obvious sole gap
pending: User approval of head/body proportions and neutral pose
Actual weapon grip and guard occlusion once weapon exists
Hidden anatomy, limb separation and overlapping seams

limits: This is one flattened neutral study, not independent completed body layers
Empty authored SVG part groups are authoring placeholders, not delivered appearance resources
No animation, app code, new IPA or physical iPad test
